result.content: # Complete the required API and report.

Stage 1: configuration_changes; work sample 0.
Implement evaluate(request, policy). Start with policy.defaults and apply layers in order. Unknown keys fail with unknown_key. Null resets to defaults only when policy.null_resets is true. Environment overrides require policy.environment and known keys. Parse boolean only from exact true/false strings; parse integers only from signed decimal strings. Invalid environment values fail with environment. Enforce exact policy types; booleans are not integers. Type failures use type. Return {ok, config, error}; failures have empty config, successes have null error. Preserve explicit false, zero, and empty strings.
Write work.py with this API. Also write report.json as a JSON array of evaluate results for requests.json, using current policy.json and evidence.json when present. Keep prior supported behavior. Use actual local checks. Store findings and unresolved limits for the next agent.

diff --git a/work.py b/work.py
index 90aaa01..856c7c6 100644
--- a/work.py
+++ b/work.py
@@ -1 +1,101 @@
-# Complete the required API and report.
+"""Evaluate layered configuration requests against a policy."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import json
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+_INTEGER = re.compile(r"[+-]?[0-9]+\Z")
+
+def _failure(error: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {"ok": False, "config": {}, "error": error}
+
+def _has_exact_type(value: Any, expected: str) -> bool:
+    if expected == "boolean":
+        return type(value) is bool
+    if expected == "integer":
+        return type(value) is int
+    if expected == "string":
+        return type(value) is str
+    return False
+
+def _parse_environment(value: Any, expected: str) -> tuple[bool, Any]:
+    if type(value) is not str:
+        return False, None
+    if expected == "boolean":
+        if value == "true":
+            return True, True
+        if value == "false":
+            return True, False
+        return False, None
+    if expected == "integer":
+        if _INTEGER.fullmatch(value) is None:
+            return False, None
+        return True, int(value, 10)
+    if expected == "string":
+        return True, value
+    return False, None
+
+def evaluate(request: dict[str, Any], policy: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    defaults = policy.get("defaults", {})
+    types = policy.get("types", {})
+    if type(defaults) is not dict or type(types) is not dict:
+        return _failure("type")
+
+    known = set(defaults)
+    config = copy.deepcopy(defaults)
+    layers = request.get("layers", [])
+    if type(layers) is not list:
+        return _failure("type")
+
+    for layer in layers:
+        if type(layer) is not dict:
+            return _failure("type")
+        for key, value in layer.items():
+            if key not in known:
+                return _failure("unknown_key")
+            if value is None and policy.get("null_resets") is True:
+                config[key] = copy.deepcopy(defaults[key])
+                continue
+            expected = types.get(key)
+            if not _has_exact_type(value, expected):
+                return _failure("type")
+            config[key] = copy.deepcopy(value)
+
+    environment_present = "environment" in request or "env" in request
+    environment = request.get("environment", request.get("env"))
+    if environment_present:
+        if policy.get("environment") is not True:
+            return _failure("environment")
+        if type(environment) is not dict:
+            return _failure("environment")
+        for key, raw_value in environment.items():
+            if key not in known:
+                return _failure("unknown_key")
+            valid, value = _parse_environment(raw_value, types.get(key))
+            if not valid:
+                return _failure("environment")
+            config[key] = value
+
+    for key, value in config.items():
+        if key not in types or not _has_exact_type(value, types[key]):
+            return _failure("type")
+
+    return {"ok": True, "config": config, "error": None}
+
+def _build_report(base: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    with (base / "policy.json").open(encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+        policy = json.load(stream)
+    with (base / "requests.json").open(encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+        requests = json.load(stream)
+    return [evaluate(request, policy) for request in requests]
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    base = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+    report = _build_report(base)
+    with (base / "report.json").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+        json.dump(report, stream, indent=2)
+        stream.write("\n")
